provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Two sites each occupy exactly one of their two alternative positions. A contact occurs iff the distance of the occupied A and B positions is <=cutoff. Treat each listed occupancy as an exact marginal probability for this controlled ensemble. No joint-state occupancies, coupling model or independence assumption is supplied.
target: Use every geometry pair to identify the contact event, then optimize its probability over ALL nonnegative 2x2 joint-state probability tables consistent with both marginals. Also report the counterfactual independence value, explicitly distinguishing it from an identified probability.
scope: A controlled alternate-position occupancy model, not measured bond occupancy, an experimental PDB refinement result, interaction affinity or protein engineering.
